# Governance

Larixy Platform AB has final authority over the project's roadmap, architecture, releases and merge decisions. The project has no voting body or elected technical committee.

Maintainers are Larixy Platform AB staff who have write access to the repository. Larixy Platform AB resolves any disagreements between maintainers.

External contributions do not grant voting rights, commit access, employment or decision-making authority. Maintainers may seek advice from external contributors and may choose to act on it.

## Licence and contributor rights

Source code owned by Larixy Platform AB in this repository is distributed under the [GNU Affero General Public License, version 3.0 or later](https://github.com/Lyxtem/larixy/blob/main/LICENSE). The licence permits its use, modification and redistribution subject to its terms.

Larixy Platform AB does not require contributors to sign a contributor licence agreement or assign their copyright. Contributors retain the copyright in their work.

Every commit made by a contributor must include the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org) sign-off required by the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/Lyxtem/larixy/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). Pull requests opened by Larixy repository automation are exempt from this requirement.

## Name and marks

Larixy and the Larixy logo are trademarks of Larixy Platform AB. Neither the AGPL nor the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence on Larixy artwork grants trademark rights. Larixy Platform AB grants everyone the following permissions.

- You may distribute unmodified builds of Larixy, or builds with light patches, under the Larixy name and logo. Light patches are changes for packaging, portability, security and bug fixes, configuration defaults and translations. Linux distributions, nixpkgs, Flathub and container images are all covered.
- A self-hosted instance running such a build may show the Larixy name and logo under the instance's own name and domain, as long as it does not imply affiliation with or endorsement by Larixy Platform AB.
- You may refer to Larixy by name to describe compatibility, for example "works with Larixy".

Forks with substantive functional changes must use their own name and logo. Any other use needs permission from Larixy Platform AB. Contact support@larixy.xyz.
